part.text:
Fixed. In `src/main.c`:

- `--` no longer requires a program to be already set; it now always stops option parsing (src/main.c:372).
- In the `args_done` branch, if no program has been seen yet, the next argument becomes the jq program (src/main.c:357).

Verified in the container:
- `jq --null-input --args -- '$ARGS' foo bar baz --zorch` → positional args `["foo","bar","baz","--zorch"]`
- `jq -n --jsonargs null -- invalid` still exits 2 (existing regression test)
- `make check` in the container: 8/8 test suites pass
